Key requirements / constraints:
- Workload: high-concurrency chat + tool-calls; long-lived streaming sessions; websockets/HTTP streaming critical.
- Latency SLOs: 95th perc. first-byte streaming <= 350ms target on US regions; tool-call roundtrip <200ms for internal actions.
